notes.title: Let's Play Bubsy In: The Purrfect Collection w/ Limited Run Games
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="WZEhrMtfy1g;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Depending on your point of reference, Bubsy is either a figure to be revered or reprimanded for his stamp on platforming history. Fortunately, thanks to our friends at Limited Run Games, you can experience the history of this legendary bobcat through his classic adventures in the upcoming Bubsy In: The Purrfect Collection. LRG has leveraged their Carbon Engine to ensure each game gets it’s proper shake with some additional quality-of-life features, but you’ll have to watch/listen to learn the details. Joining me for this are LRG’s Audi Sorlie (Producer), Joe Modzeleski (Development Director), and Sam Brown (Release Manager and Atari Bubsy enthusiast).[/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist Bubsy In: The Purrfect Collection:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3039890/Bubsy_in_The_Purrfect_Collection/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Bubsy’s back in Bubsy 4D! Get ready for a brand new intergalactic adventure!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="H4bq6P8e5gk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Join Bubsy on an intergalactic, platforming adventure! The infamous, wise-cracking bobcat has returned to 3D with new challenges, new moves, and even more purrsonality. Run, jump, glide, and roll across alien planets, battle robotic sheep, and collect tons and tons of yarn. What could possibly go wrong?[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237970/Bubsy_4D/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Bubsy’s longstanding enemies, the fleece-obsessed Woolies, have stolen all of the Earth’s sheep. Oh well, that ain’t Bubsy’s problem. Until the sheep return as deadly BaaBots, empowered by Woolie technology, to steal The Golden Fleece. Bubsy must journey through space to stop the BaaBots and reclaim the Fleece with the help of his motley crew of acquaintances. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068270/43a2e04492b19554d952735df8bacead4f0ccfc0.png"][/img][/p][p]Luckily, Bubsy has acquired new skills to navigate the craft-themed levels. He can leap, glide, flip, claw up walls, and pounce off enemies. He can also puff up into a new hairball form to roll at blistering speeds. The team at Fabraz crafted this expressive new moveset to cater to beginners and speedrun enthusiasts alike. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068270/f6905e6e1adffc4e7a4ac61bd8a7e44cab4539fa.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]A 3D PLATFORMING ADVENTURE – IN SPACE![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Features[/b][/p][p]INTERGALACTIC 3D PLATFORMER[/p][p]New craft-themed worlds, clawsome moves, and epic boss battles. What more could you want? [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068270/32e8ca7288ad0e5f1d18190e7be9b0a9835fbe3a.png"][/img][/p][p]EVEN MORE CATITUDE[/p][p]The world’s most infamous, wise-cracking bobcat is back. Bubsy brings even more purrsonality and puns in this new adventure. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068270/fe6862acc41ee30d2accbe0d0f2b82850f4dc52a.png"][/img][/p][p]NEW HAIRBALL FORM[/p][p]Puff up into a hairball to bounce around and roll at blistering speeds. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068270/cd6d652087b03ae9ec78138c0d5f559314dfca47.png"][/img][/p][p]ONLINE LEADERBOARDS[/p][p]Upload your best speedrun times to online leaderboards for other players to see (and try to beat).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068270/3b2ff5bed9e3f5b0cf5ec5ae4771a8e618035f62.png"][/img][/p][p]PAWSITIVELY FUNKY SOUNDTRACK[/p][p]Music by Fat Bard, incorporating elements of jazz, big band, electro-swing and more.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068270/f1874a7acf2ee93966497b9080104c303d1ad3f2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection Releases September 9, 2025!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="APBdZWwUeBE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]That's right Bubsy fans, Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection releases digitally on September 9, 2025![/p][p][/p][p]First appearing in 1993, the wise-cracking Bobcat found instant fame through a series of platforming adventures, raising smiles with his constant puns, tight gameplay and loveable cast of characters. Now, some 32 years later, the loveable furball makes a triumphant return, purrfect for long time fans or newcomers to his brand of anarchic entertainment.[/p][p][/p][p]So what’s in store for retro feline fanatics who are willing to take on this trained purr-fessional?[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection[/i] [/b]contains SIX classic Bubsy titles:[/p][list][*][p]Bubsy in: Claws Encounters of the Furred Kind (Super & Mega versions)[/p][/*][*][p]Bubsy II (Super, Mega and Portable version)[/p][/*][*][p]Bubsy in: Fractured Furry Tales[/p][/*][*][p]Bubsy is 3D in “The Furbitten Planet”[/p][/*][*][p]Yamaneko Bubsy no Daibouken[/p][/*][*][p]Bubsy 3D ReFurBished[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]But that's not all! [/p][p][/p][p]Discerning fans of the iconic 90s mascot, will be pleased to learn that Limited Run Games has created something a little special for you to get your claws into. There’s a limited edition Bubsy plushie that any Bobcat aficionado would be fur-ious to miss. There’s also an exclusive Bubsy t-shirt, with a yet-to-be revealed design, that will showcase the true cat-titude of any wearer.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Standard Edition (Xbox, Switch, PS5, PC)[/b][/p][p]

notes.title: Bubsy in: Fractured Furry Tales will be playable in the Purrfect Collection!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068270/1c9d1aa015c0d56630f5a0b20ca2e577e8e58e25.png[/img]
Today, Atari and Limited Run Games revealed the list of titles included in Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection, the upcoming playable history of everyone’s fur-vorite bobcat mascot, Bubsy. Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection will bring Bubsy in Fractured Furry Tales (Atari Jaguar), Bubsy in Claws Encounters of the Furred Kind (SEGA Genesis, Super Nintendo, Super Famicom), Bubsy II (Game Boy, Sega Genesis, Super Nintendo) and Bubsy 3D (PlayStation) to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam and Nintendo Switch.

Developed by Limited Run Games’ Carbon Engine team, Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection includes eight classic Bubsy games alongside artifacts and interviews providing insight into the creation and legacy of our furry friend. All games in the collection have been carefully updated for modern systems, smoothing out rough edges with new quality of life features and technical upgrades while staying true to the quirky catitude Bubsy is known for.

Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection is the ultimate celebration of Bubsy’s legacy and a great opportunity for fans and newcomers alike to experience his fur-tastic catalog like never before. Get ready to pounce into the decades-spanning history of Bubsy and friends, taking on platforming challenges, gathering collectibles and bashing baddies into oblivion while discovering all there is to know about the feisty feline franchise. 

“Here we go again! I’m pawsitively pumped to bring my collection of purrfectly preserved pixels to cool cats everywhere,” said Bubsy T. Bobcat. “Hold onto your whiskers and get ready for a glide down memory lane, polished and pampered for your playing pleasure. What could possibly go wrong?”

Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection is coming soon to Steam, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch. Don’t fur-get to wishlist!
